name: Upward-Facing Dog
steps: Lie face down with your legs long, the tops of your feet on the floor and your palms beside your lower ribs.
Press through your hands and feet to straighten your arms and lift your chest and thighs clear of the floor.
Draw your shoulders down and back away from your ears while opening your chest forward and upward.
Hold the open front-body stretch steadily while breathing calmly, then lower your knees and torso gently back to the floor.
tips: Squeeze your glutes lightly and engage your abs gently to support your lower back in the arch.
Press through the tops of your feet so your thighs stay lifted and your legs help support the pose.
